papers.title: Association between diabetes and elevated circulating advanced oxidation protein products: a comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Iqbal M, Khan M, Farooqui S, Zahid Iqbal M, Khan S, Khan N, Seshadri V, Abdelgawwad El-Sehrawy A
papers.abstract: Oxidative stress is a central feature of the metabolic disturbances observed in diabetes, often leading to cellular and molecular damage. Advanced oxidation protein products (AOPPs), formed during oxidative modification of plasma proteins, have been proposed as biomarkers of systemic oxidative stress. Despite increasing interest, the relationship between these markers and diabetes remains inconclusive. This study aimed to systematically evaluate and quantify differences in circulating AOPPs levels in diabetes. A systematic review and meta-analysis was performed in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. Searches were conducted across PubMed, Scopus, Embase and Web of Science databases up to March 2025 to identify relevant observational studies involving adults aged 18 years or older. Studies were included if they reported circulating levels of AOPPs in individuals with type 1 diabetes (T1DM), type 2 diabetes (T2DM), or impaired fasting glucose (IFG) or impaired glucose tolerance (IGT), compared to non-diabetic controls. Data extraction and quality assessment were conducted independently by two reviewers, and a random-effects model was used for meta-analysis. Sixteen eligible articles with twenty individual studies were identified, encompassing diverse populations and diabetes subtypes. The meta-analysis demonstrated significantly elevated circulating AOPPs in both T1DM (WMD ≈ 17.5 µmol/L) and T2DM (WMD ≈ 24.68 µmol/L) compared with controls, though heterogeneity was high. Subgroup analyses confirmed the consistent direction of effect, with stronger associations in younger populations, studies with higher baseline AOPPs, and certain designs or regions. Meta-regression showed that examined moderators (continent, study design, baseline AOPPs, age, sample size, gender, study quality, presence of overweight/ obesity, hypertension, smoking and abnormal serum lipids) explained little to none of the variability. Sensitivity analyses indicated that results were robust. Publication bias assessment revealed funnel plot asymmetry for type 2 diabetes, but trim-and-fill analysis did not materially alter the pooled estimates, supporting the stability of the findings. Elevated levels of AOPPs appear to be associated with diabetes, supporting the role of oxidative stress in its pathophysiology. Although pooled analyses demonstrated significantly higher circulating AOPP concentrations in patients with diabetes mellitus, substantial between-study heterogeneity and wide prediction intervals suggest that the magnitude and consistency of this association may vary across different populations and study settings. Also, the observational design of included studies limits the strength and generalizability of the pooled estimates. Therefore, causal inferences cannot be drawn, and further well-designed prospective research is warranted to clarify whether these biomarkers can reliably predict the onset or progression of diabetes. > [!info] 品質快照
> 設計：systematic review and meta-analysis，納入 16 篇文章、20 個 individual studies
> 族群：成人 T1DM、T2DM、IFG 或 IGT，與非糖尿病 controls 比較 circulating AOPPs
> GRADE：Very low。摘要層級評分由 deterministic grade_judge 計算，待全文後重算。
> 一句話 verdict：AOPPs 在糖尿病族群較高的關聯訊號一致，但數值差異跨族群變動大，不能據此判定 AOPPs 會造成糖尿病、能預測病程，或可直接作為臨床篩檢工具。

## Summary

> Abstract-level review only。文章摘要支持 association，不支持因果推論。

- T1DM pooled WMD 約 17.5 micromol/L。
- T2DM pooled WMD 約 24.68 micromol/L。
- 研究間 heterogeneity 高，prediction intervals 寬。
- meta-regression 涵蓋 continent、study design、age、sample size、gender、quality、overweight/obesity、hypertension、smoking 與 lipids，但解釋的變異很少。
- T2DM 有 funnel plot asymmetry，trim-and-fill 沒有實質改變估計值。

## 白話導讀

> [!abstract] 整篇講給你聽
> AOPPs 是蛋白質氧化後形成的一類循環生物標記。這篇彙整發現糖尿病患者平均值較高，支持糖尿病與 oxidative stress 同時存在的觀察。研究把 AOPPs 當成關聯指標來討論，還沒有證明它是糖尿病的原因，也沒有證明單獨量 AOPPs 能診斷、預測或改善病人的重要結局。

## Paper Details

### PICO

- Population：成人 T1DM、T2DM、IFG 或 IGT。
- Comparison：非糖尿病 controls。
- Outcome：circulating AOPPs level。
- Design：觀察性研究的 systematic review and meta-analysis。
- Methods from abstract：搜尋 PubMed、Scopus、Embase、Web of Science 至 2025 年 3 月，由兩位 reviewer 獨立擷取資料與品質評估，使用 random-effects model。

### 主要結果

| Diabetes subgroup | Pooled result | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| T1DM | WMD 約 17.5 micromol/L | 平均 AOPPs 較高，但異質性限制外推 |
| T2DM | WMD 約 24.68 micromol/L | 方向一致，大小受族群與研究設計影響 |

Sensitivity analyses 顯示結果方向穩健，但穩健性不能消除 selection bias、measurement heterogeneity 或未測量混雜。

## Critical Appraisal

- **方法學優點**：多資料庫搜尋、雙人獨立擷取、random-effects model、subgroup、meta-regression、sensitivity 與 publication bias 分析都有在摘要交代。
- **主要限制**：摘要沒有呈現搜尋完整性、protocol/registration、納入研究的偏差工具與 individual estimates，也沒有足夠資訊判斷 AOPP assay、樣本處理與控制組定義的一致性。
- **偏差與異質性**：糖尿病亞型、年齡、地區、疾病 duration、併發症、腎功能、藥物與 AOPP assay 都可能造成 variation。高 heterogeneity 與寬 prediction intervals 使單一 pooled WMD 不適合作為個人臨床 cut-off。
- **Publication bias**：T2DM funnel plot asymmetry 是警訊。trim-and-fill 未改變 pooled estimate 可降低部分疑慮，無法證明不存在 selective reporting。
- **推論漏洞**：AOPPs 較高是 association。摘要結論也明確說不能推導 causal inference，且不能直接宣稱可預測 diabetes onset 或 progression。
- **臨床使用**：目前較適合作為研究性 oxidative stress marker，不宜單獨用來診斷糖尿病、調整藥物或取代 HbA1c、血糖與器官併發症評估。

## Grade calculation record

- Starting level：low，因證據體主要是觀察性研究。
- Risk of bias：serious。
- Inconsistency：very serious。
- Indirectness：serious。
- Imprecision：serious。
- Publication bias：serious。
- Deterministic result：Very low。

papers.title: Sarcopenia and body composition abnormalities in chronic pancreatitis: Pathophysiology, assessment, and clinical impact.
papers.authors: Bonsdorff A, Oyon D, Klatte D, Pauw H, Plecic N, Blazevic N, Regner S, Overbeek K
papers.abstract: Chronic pancreatitis is a progressive inflammatory disease associated with substantial nutritional and metabolic consequences. Beyond classical malnutrition, patients frequently develop alterations in body composition, particularly sarcopenia, which are increasingly recognised as clinically relevant but remain inconsistently assessed. The reported prevalence of sarcopenia ranges from 20% to 70%, including a substantial proportion of patients with normal or elevated body mass index. Sarcopenia reflects the combined effects of chronic inflammation, pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, endocrine dysfunction, reduced oral intake, malabsorption, and lifestyle factors such as alcohol use, smoking, and physical inactivity. Advances in imaging and functional assessment allow more precise evaluation of muscle mass, fat distribution, and bone density. Computed tomography-derived skeletal muscle indices, often obtained from routine imaging, provide accurate muscle mass quantification, while handgrip strength and gait speed capture clinically meaningful functional impairment. Observational studies associate sarcopenia with increased healthcare utilisation, higher mortality, and poorer surgical outcomes, although heterogeneity in definitions and study design limits causal inference. Most studies rely on CT-derived muscle mass as the sole diagnostic criterion, consistent with pre-EWGSOP2 frameworks, rather than incorporating muscle strength - typically assessed by grip strength - as now recommended by current consensus groups. Evidence regarding sarcopenic obesity, myosteatosis, and ectopic fat deposition remains limited. Structured nutritional assessment, including the GLIM criteria for malnutrition diagnosis, alongside systematic body composition evaluation and multidisciplinary nutritional and exercise-based interventions, may improve risk stratification and outcomes. Further longitudinal and interventional studies are needed to define disease-specific thresholds and optimise management strategies.

> [!info] 品質快照
> 設計：narrative review
> 核心問題：chronic pancreatitis 中 sarcopenia、body composition 與臨床結局
> GRADE：n.a.，敘述性回顧沒有單一可直接計算的 evidence body
> 一句話 verdict：文章把 chronic pancreatitis 的營養評估從單純體重拉回肌力、肌肉量與脂肪分布，方向符合臨床需求，但 prevalence、死亡與手術風險多來自異質性觀察研究，不能把關聯直接當成介入效果。

## Summary

> Abstract-level review only。缺少全文時，以下數字與方法細節需回到原文核對。

- sarcopenia prevalence 約 20% 至 70%，即使 BMI 正常或偏高也可能存在。
- 可能成因包括慢性發炎、pancreatic exocrine insufficiency、endocrine dysfunction、攝取不足、malabsorption、酒精、吸菸與缺乏活動。
- CT-derived skeletal muscle index 可利用既有影像量化肌肉量，handgrip strength 與 gait speed 則反映功能。
- 多數研究只用 CT muscle mass，仍沿用 pre-EWGSOP2 思路，沒有納入現在重視的 muscle strength。
- GLIM malnutrition assessment、body composition、營養介入與 exercise-based intervention 可用來改善風險分層，長期介入證據仍不足。

## 白話導讀

> [!abstract] 整篇講給你聽
> 慢性胰臟炎的營養問題不只看體重或 BMI。病人可能外觀看起來不瘦，卻有肌肉量不足、肌力下降、肌肉脂肪化與骨密度問題。臨床上要把既有 CT、握力、步速、飲食吸收、胰外分泌功能與 GLIM 營養診斷放在一起，才比較能看見真正的功能風險。

## Paper Details

### Pathophysiology

- chronic inflammation、pancreatic exocrine insufficiency、endocrine dysfunction、reduced oral intake 與 malabsorption 共同影響 lean mass。
- Alcohol use、smoking、physical inactivity 會再加重身體組成異常。
- sarcopenic obesity、myosteatosis 與 ectopic fat 是重要但資料有限的表型。

### Assessment

- Muscle mass：CT-derived skeletal muscle indices，常可從既有腹部影像取得。
- Muscle strength：handgrip strength。
- Physical performance：gait speed。
- Malnutrition：GLIM criteria。
- 單用 CT muscle mass 可能漏掉肌力下降，也可能因不同 cut-off 與影像層面造成 prevalence 差異。

### Clinical associations

摘要指出 sarcopenia 與較高 healthcare utilisation、mortality 及 poorer surgical outcomes 有關，但這些多是觀察性關聯，可能受到疾病嚴重度、營養吸收、酒精、癌症疑慮、手術選擇與共病混雜。

## Critical Appraisal

- **優點**：把 body composition、muscle strength、GLIM 與多專業營養及運動介入放在同一臨床框架。
- **主要偏差風險**：摘要未交代搜尋策略、研究納入標準、各研究定義與 quality assessment，無法確認引用是否涵蓋相反結果。
- **異質性**：sarcopenia prevalence 20% 至 70% 的範圍很大，可能來自 CT cut-off、族群、疾病期別、BMI、酒精暴露與量測方法不同。
- **時代差異**：多數研究以 CT muscle mass 作為唯一診斷條件，與現在強調 muscle strength 的共識不同，會造成 disease burden 低估或分類不一致。
- **推論漏洞**：與死亡、手術與醫療使用的關聯不等於 sarcopenia 本身造成這些結果。沒有 longitudinal 或 intervention evidence 時，不能直接保證營養與運動介入會降低死亡。
- **實務建議**：把握力、步速、CT body composition、飲食攝取、胰酵素替代與 GLIM 放進同一評估流程，再依個人狀態安排營養與運動方案。
